expect.offline: The form waits for the last node (responseMode lastNode); the bench pins the trigger's item, so no browser waits. 'Recent' is n8n's clock in the Code node (start of today in New York minus 3 days), so publish times are relative to the run ({{bench.now-…}}, P90). The Telegram chat id is $env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, a placeholder the overlay fills (env on the n8n side, a step value on the Claude side), as for 3025 and 3291. The Google API key is placeholder text the overlay fills.
